modeled_onsite_gas_generation_cost_usd_p.dataset_vintage: derived from EIA state industrial natural-gas price (fuel-only)
modeled_onsite_gas_generation_cost_usd_p.notes: industrial natural-gas price / 1.037 MMBtu/Mcf x 9.5 MMBtu/MWh genset heat rate. MODELED fuel-only screen, NOT a delivered-power quote. Excludes capital recovery, O&M, emissions, gas delivery/demand charges. Comparing (grid vs gas) is asymmetric — grid is all-in retail, gas is fuel-only — so grid_price > modeled_gas_cost means 'worth deeper study,' NOT 'build gas.' Actual economics require operator confirmation of pipeline pressure, firm transport, lead time, and permit timelines. An efficient combined-cycle (~6.4 MMBtu/MWh) would be ~33% lower.
